mapper.select: SELECT r.approval_id AS approvalId, r.approval_revision_id AS revisionId, r.revision_no AS revisionNo, r.status AS status, r.title AS title, r.content AS content FROM approval_revision r WHERE r.approval_id IN #{id} AND r.deleted_at IS NULL AND r.revision_no = ( SELECT MAX(r2.revision_no) FROM approval_revision r2 WHERE r2.approval_id = r.approval_id AND r2.deleted_at IS NULL )

SELECT al.approval_revision_id AS revisionId, al.status AS status, CASE WHEN e.user_id IS NULL OR e.resigned_at IS NOT NULL OR e.deleted_at IS NOT NULL OR a.status IS NULL OR a.status <> 'ACTIVE' THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS approverUnavailable FROM approval_line al LEFT JOIN employee e ON e.user_id = al.user_id LEFT JOIN account a ON a.user_id = e.user_id WHERE al.approval_revision_id IN #{id} AND al.deleted_at IS NULL
